items.title: Pay outstanding invoice for sideboard order
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den offenen Betrag bitte bis Freitag, 28.08.2026.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis Freitag, 28.08.2026'. 28.08.2026 is indeed a Friday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The due date is simply the date as printed.

warnings: This is a payment reminder from a private company (not an authority), so no statutory deemed-delivery or objection-period rules apply; the due date is simply the date printed.

The letter itself politely notes that if payment was already made it should be ignored — worth checking bank statements from around 24.07.2026–18.08.2026 before paying again to avoid a duplicate payment.

The IBAN (DE02 3705 0198 0002 5090 90) is a validly formatted German IBAN matching the sender's country, which is reassuring, but a valid format does not prove the account belongs to Beispiel Wohnwelt GmbH; compare it with the IBAN on the original order confirmation/invoice before transferring.

The session's 'today' date was stated inconsistently (2026-08-23 in the main instructions vs. 2026-09-30 in a later reminder); if today is actually on or after 2026-09-30, the stated due date of 28.08.2026 has already passed and the person should check for any follow-up letters or late fees.
